title: Kagurabachi Reveals When Its Next Major Anime Update Is Coming
content: Kagurabachi has emerged as one of the biggest Shonen Jump series of recent times, and its anime adaptation was something fans had been excited about even before the manga’s pages were officially published and circulated.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Street Fighter Film's Trailer Features Cast's Comments About Franchise
content: Paramount Pictures started streaming "The Love of Street Fighter" trailer for Legendary Entertainment 's live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series on Friday, featuring the film's actors commenting about the Street Fighter franchise with some behind-the-scenes footage.
author: ANN

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Shares First Look at Its Final Releases
content: Launched in 1968, Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has serialized at least more than a thousand series, but only a handful of them made their mark in history. While series such as Dragon Ball and Naruto became timeless classics, countless promising stories were axed before they could get a chance.
author: ComicBook

title: Welsh & Shedar Anime Streams on YouTube in November
content: The anime premiered on Friday on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT). The anime's story centers on a country boy named Welsh, and a prince destined to become a king named Shedar.
author: ANN

title: New Fantasy Isekai Anime Looks to Be the Next Big Thing – Watch Trailer
content: The final quarter of the year is now here, which means all the Fall 2026 anime shows will begin to premiere one after the other. 2026 has been a huge year for isekai fans since it’s one of the most popular genres in the industry.
author: ComicBook

title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan, #I'm Looking For Zombie, Reborn as a Space Mercenary Anime Get Same-Day English Dubs
content: Crunchyroll began streaming the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga on Thursday. title: Tokyo Revengers Season 4 Releases Creditless Opening Featuring JO1's "IGNITE"
content: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) has released the creditless opening sequence for, featuring JO1’s opening theme “IGNITE.” The anime previously revealed the voice cast for the founding members of Black Dragon , as well as South Terano.
author: Anime Corner

title: Toonami Airs Wind Breaker, Gachiakuta Anime
content: Adult Swim 's Toonami programming block revealed on Friday that it will air both the Wind Breaker and Gachiakuta anime in the United States starting on October 10 and 17, repsectively (effectively, October 11 and 18). The block will also add the Get Jiro! animated series on October 10.
author: ANN

title: 5 Forgotten Anime So Good They Deserve a Live-Action Series Now
content: Anime has officially entered the live-action era, whether Hollywood is ready for it or not. After One Piece showed that a live-action adaptation could actually do a decent job of staying true to what makes its source material special, the possibilities have started rolling out.
author: ComicBook

title: Viz Media Licenses The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Manga
content: The fantasy romance manga centers on seven brothers who are knights of the Marronnier Kingdom. The kingdom lies in the center of a group of eight kingdoms, and each brother is dispatched to a different kingdom as ambassadors, to go on an adventure to find their fated partner.
author: ANN
